subject: english
title: Unit 9 Quiz App — The Science of Fun
subtitle: Assessment after Unit 9 · the ExamView L4U9 quiz · 10 parts · 36 questions · 50 points · no right/wrong shown while answering

content: Match the playground picture to what you hear on TR 9.1, and complete the skiing sentences from TR 9.2.
Use the Unit 9 force words — push, pull, spin, friction, gravity, balance — in matching and in full sentences.
Read 'Forces on a Roller Coaster' and 'Friction, Centripetal Force, and Gravity' and answer true/false and multiple choice.
Write 3 to 4 sentences about one playground activity, and answer the six speaking prompts from the picture.
language: Build the double comparative: the more you practice, the faster you run.
Define a thing with which, changing the phrase to fit: a fruit which has a yellow peel.
Describe direction and movement: forward, backward, spin, lean, lose your balance.
Link cause and effect with so, so that and as a result.
